answer.summary: API Types Check fails because the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts is stale. Regenerating from the API adds fields the PR did not commit (e.g. has_more, last_verified_at, tenant_name). The same diff will reproduce on re-run. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the result.
